mechanics.claim: Hijack steals a copy of the target's ultimate ability and can later recast it at no cost.
mechanics.quote: gaining a copy of their {{tip|champion ability|ultimate ability}}

mechanics.claim: The recast of the hijacked ultimate costs no resource.
mechanics.quote: '''Sylas''' casts his ''hijacked'' ability at no cost.

mechanics.claim: Hijacked abilities lacking AP scaling have their AD ratios converted into AP ratios, scaled by Sylas's own AP.
mechanics.quote: ''Hijacked'' abilities that do not scale with {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} have their {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}} ratios converted to {{as|ability power}} ratios.

mechanics.claim: The stolen ability scales based on Hijack's own rank and Sylas's stats, not the target's ability rank.
mechanics.quote: scaling based on ''Hijack's'' rank and his own [[Champion statistic|statistics]]

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast and restarts either upon recast or when the hold duration expires.
mechanics.quote: Starts on cast and restarts on recast or when hold duration ends

mechanics.claim: Sylas cannot select the same enemy champion again until a per-target cooldown expires; it is 200% of the target's base ultimate cooldown (minimum 40s) and starts on steal, not on casting the stolen ability.
mechanics.quote: 200% of target's base ultimate cooldown|A minimum of 40 second cooldown. Starts on steal, rather than on casting the stolen ability.

mechanics.claim: Hijack applies a spell shield-blockable, targeted projectile that can be intercepted, granting Sylas a copy of the interceptor's ultimate instead.
mechanics.quote: If ''Hijack'' is intercepted by {{cai|Unbreakable|Braum}}, '''Sylas''' will gain a copy of {{ai|R|Braum}} instead
